note: one terminal per input column (the loader expands `var` to every column)
raw division: its domain differs from pdiv; a protected form is never mapped to a raw one
raw square root: not in the alphabet, psqrt is
raw logarithm: not in the alphabet, plog is
raw exponential: not in the alphabet, pexp is
raw inverse: not in the alphabet, pinv is
raw arcsine: not in the alphabet, pasin is
raw arccosine: not in the alphabet, pacos is
binary power: wide() has no Pow; a literal exponent 2 or 3 canonicalises to pow2/pow3, any other exponent is not offered (never typed by the binary merge rule: it would count the exponent as an arm)
ternary select: a WGSL-kingdom row, not in the SR alphabet
Pow(x, 2) with the literal 2 becomes pow2(x), order preserved (canonicalises to pow2)
Pow(x, 3) with the literal 3 becomes pow3(x), order preserved (canonicalises to pow3)
